propositions: AWS Bedrock must be registered as a first-class provider in rebar's builder factory, constructing pydantic-ai's native BedrockConverseModel with BedrockProvider via ambient AWS credential chain, with no rebar-managed keys

Prompt caching on Bedrock works only for certain inference profile model IDs and fails silently without warning; rebar must detect cache_read_tokens==0 AND cache_write_tokens==0 with nonzero input and emit a WARNING naming the model ID so operators are not billed full input on every call

The temperature sampling parameter is deprecated and rejected with HTTP 400 on some Bedrock models; rebar must omit it when supports_temperature capability is False, using an exact-id override table keyed by measured model IDs rather than provider prefix matching

Provider-agnostic error translation in src/rebar/llm/failure.py must catch 400 ValidationExceptions naming a deprecated sampling parameter and surface an actionable LLMConfigError naming the model ID, parameter, and both remedies (add to override table or unset config)
The [bedrock] optional extra must be added to the dev install group so Bedrock-specific unit tests run in CI without boto3 becoming a default runtime dependency of pip install nava-rebar[agents]

Capabilities record must be widened with supports_temperature field and a second _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES table applied after profile-based overrides, preserving f184's immutable _REBAR_OVERRIDES signature and zero provider-name prefix matching in capabilities.py
